# A retail UO 1.51 client (CoDUOMP.exe under Wine, a cmd every 8 ms or so) as the flame
# victim of probe_rc_flame on mp_cassino; capture retail-client-2026-11-24,
# step 5-fdc, client.log slot 0 (2026-11-24). Cut by
# `tools/capture/retail-client/analyze.py fdc-fixture`.
# One frame per cmd from the first raised flag to the last fdc: `start` is
# the first cmd's serverTime, `steps` each next one's step from it (ms),
# `flags` each cmd's wbuttons 0x1, `fdc` the serverTimes of the cmds whose
# packet carried an fdc. A cmd's serverTime is the cg.time of the draw that
# set its flag.
